tasks.name: E-Commerce Financial Aggregation without Join Fan-Out
tasks.reason: Data discrepancy: DataFrame.iloc[:, 2] (column name="total_gross_sales") are different
tasks.candidate_sql:
SELECT
    m.merchant_id,
    m.merchant_name,
    SUM(o.base_amount) AS total_gross_sales,
    SUM(d.amount) AS total_discount_amount,
    SUM(s.shipping_fee) AS total_shipping_fees
FROM merchants m
JOIN orders o ON m.merchant_id = o.merchant_id
LEFT JOIN order_discounts d ON o.order_id = d.order_id
LEFT JOIN order_shipments s ON o.order_id = s.order_id
GROUP BY m.merchant_id, m.merchant_name;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH agg_discounts AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS total_discount
    FROM order_discounts
    GROUP BY order_id
),
agg_shipments AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(shipping_fee) AS total_shipping
    FROM order_shipments
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
    m.merchant_id,
    m.merchant_name,
    SUM(o.base_amount) AS total_gross_sales,
    COALESCE(SUM(d.total_discount), 0.00) AS total_discount_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.total_shipping), 0.00) AS total_shipping_fees
FROM merchants m
JOIN orders o ON m.merchant_id = o.merchant_id
LEFT JOIN agg_discounts d ON o.order_id = d.order_id
LEFT JOIN agg_shipments s ON o.order_id = s.order_id
GROUP BY m.merchant_id, m.merchant_name;

tasks.name: Clickstream Sessionization with Inactivity Gaps
tasks.reason: Shape mismatch: Expected 3 rows x 5 cols, got 5 rows x 5 cols
tasks.candidate_sql:
SELECT
    user_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM user_events
GROUP BY user_id, event_timestamp
ORDER BY user_id ASC, session_start ASC;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH lagged AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE 
                 OR LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_new_session
    FROM user_events
),
session_indexed AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CAST(SUM(is_new_session) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS BIGINT) AS session_id
    FROM lagged
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM session_indexed
GROUP BY user_id, session_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC, session_start ASC;

tasks.name: Historical SCD Type 2 Point-in-Time Currency Conversion
tasks.reason: Shape mismatch: Expected 3 rows x 5 cols, got 1 rows x 5 cols
tasks.candidate_sql:
SELECT
    t.txn_id,
    t.currency,
    t.amount,
    r.rate_to_usd,
    ROUND(t.amount * r.rate_to_usd, 2) AS amount_usd
FROM transactions t
JOIN exchange_rates r
  ON t.currency = r.currency
 AND t.txn_time >= r.valid_from
 AND t.txn_time <= r.valid_to
ORDER BY t.txn_id ASC;
tasks.golden_sql:
SELECT
    t.txn_id,
    t.currency,
    t.amount,
    r.rate_to_usd,
    ROUND(t.amount * r.rate_to_usd, 2) AS amount_usd
FROM transactions t
JOIN exchange_rates r
  ON t.currency = r.currency
 AND t.txn_time >= r.valid_from
 AND (t.txn_time < r.valid_to OR r.valid_to IS NULL)
ORDER BY t.txn_id ASC;

tasks.name: Customer Anti-Join with Three-Valued Null Semantics
tasks.reason: Shape mismatch: Expected 2 rows x 2 cols, got 0 rows x 2 cols
tasks.candidate_sql:
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name
FROM customers c
WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (
    SELECT customer_id FROM returns
);
tasks.golden_sql:
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name
FROM customers c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM returns r WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id
);

tasks.name: Sequential Multi-Stage User Onboarding Conversion Funnel
tasks.reason: Data discrepancy: DataFrame.iloc[:, 2] (column name="converted_purchase") are different
tasks.candidate_sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'view_item' THEN user_id END) AS total_viewers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'add_to_cart' THEN user_id END) AS converted_cart,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'purchase' THEN user_id END) AS converted_purchase
FROM user_journey_events;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH user_stages AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'view_item' THEN event_time END) AS view_time,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'add_to_cart' THEN event_time END) AS cart_time,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'purchase' THEN event_time END) AS purchase_time
    FROM user_journey_events
    GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN view_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS total_viewers,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN view_time IS NOT NULL AND cart_time > view_time THEN 1 END) AS converted_cart,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN view_time IS NOT NULL AND cart_time > view_time AND purchase_time > cart_time THEN 1 END) AS converted_purchase
FROM user_stages;

tasks.name: Rolling 7-Day Window Aggregation without Quadratic Self-Joins
tasks.reason: Performance failure: Disallowed operator 'PIECEWISE_MERGE_JOIN' detected in execution plan (intermediate cardinality: 8)
tasks.candidate_sql:
SELECT
    a.revenue_date,
    a.gross_amount,
    SUM(b.gross_amount) AS rolling_7d_revenue
FROM daily_revenue a
JOIN daily_revenue b
  ON b.revenue_date BETWEEN a.revenue_date - INTERVAL 6 DAYS AND a.revenue_date
GROUP BY a.revenue_date, a.gross_amount
ORDER BY a.revenue_date ASC;
tasks.golden_sql:
SELECT
    revenue_date,
    gross_amount,
    SUM(gross_amount) OVER (
        ORDER BY revenue_date
        RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAYS PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS rolling_7d_revenue
FROM daily_revenue
ORDER BY revenue_date ASC;
